Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick reply on the pilot questions. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute technical walkthrough next week to line up the integration plan and hand off access to our infra team.

A couple constraints on our side: our engineering team in Berlin prefers mornings CEST (09:00–12:00) and Tom is in the US Pacific timezone with a preference for late afternoons PST (16:00–18:00 PST). We're trying to find a 45-min overlap without asking anyone to be on a very early or very late call. Also FYI we switch to a short internal travel blackout Friday morning when some folks are on-site.

Could you share available slots that respect those windows? We're flexible on the day — Tue/Wed/Thu next week look best.

Thanks,
Elena

Hi Elena — thanks for the constraint summary, that helps.

Quick note up front: there was a little confusion in earlier threads about whether Tom was on Pacific Standard Time or a US team observing a different offset this month — I double-checked. To avoid the usual CET/CEST mixups we should anchor times in both offsets.

Available 45-min windows (all times shown in CEST / PST):
- Tue 2026-12-08 09:30 CEST / 00:30 PST (probably too early for Tom)
- Tue 2026-12-08 11:00 CEST / 02:00 PST (still tough)
- Wed 2026-12-09 08:30 CEST / 23:30 (previous day) PST (not good)
- Thu 2026-12-10 15:30 CEST / 06:30 PST (reasonable for Berlin, early for Tom)
- Thu 2026-12-10 17:00 CEST / 08:00 PST (compromise — Tom can do 08:00)

I realize many of these push against normal hours. If the team in Berlin can shift one of their people to 08:30 CEST that would create a 17:30 PST overlap which is ideal, but I know that's not always possible.

Also, Lauren is traveling on Thursday afternoon (travel blackout 13:00–18:00 CET) so she asked me to flag that calendar constraint — we'll need someone else to cover any CS/solutions points if we pick a Thursday slot earlier.

If it helps I can send a couple of calendar proposals (one that prioritizes Berlin mornings and one that prioritizes Tom's late afternoons).

Best,
Karthik
